scope: Seven representation, cost and ancestry receivers; no biological classifier or solved SPR claim.

receivers.input_contract: Actual conditional lineage/pair/cut choices, fresh identities, dates, intervals and stopped output.
receivers.result: Retained continuous-cut marked construction transfers its count/clock law to recorded history.
receivers.limit: Not discrete links, Little-ARG absorption, common-observable coupling or production parser.

receivers.input_contract: Finite acyclic interval graph, unique local parents and specified sample-rootward arrays.
receivers.result: Exact sample-supported edge extraction; all-edge inverse needs every active edge supported.
receivers.limit: Not arbitrary full-graph, clock, metadata or byte round trip.

receivers.input_contract: Declared MRCA/support truncation, contraction and full-local-relation interval storage.
receivers.result: Specified paths preserved and canonical storage fixed point.
receivers.limit: Not whole-pipeline idempotence; sampled unary/isolated nodes and MRCA premises remain.

receivers.input_contract: Birth bk, death a*k*(k-1)/2, stopping at one; theta=2b/a.
receivers.result: Classical Griffiths/Durrett formulas connect to retained event/time projections.
receivers.limit: General-start guide deduction/review and Wong B07 convention clarification remain separate; not measured runtime.

receivers.input_contract: Onto owner map, finite fibres and finite ancestry-answer errors per rich representative.
receivers.result: IAP transfers for saturated candidate preimages.
receivers.limit: Not few-parent-edge-edit robustness, other specieslike predicates or inferred biological ownership.

receivers.input_contract: Finite demes and all five strong actual-pedigree assumptions, including universal local dissemination.
receivers.result: IAP subsets characterized by eventual single recurrent strongly connected component.
receivers.limit: Project-posed application; ordinary extinction-permitting models and finite data do not automatically satisfy it.

receivers.input_contract: Neighboring estimated local trees with partially shared internal identities.
receivers.result: A concrete computational question stated by Wong Appendix E; representation results supply prerequisites.
receivers.limit: No solution or current exhaustive open-status claim; extraction counters do not bound reconciliation complexity.
